`final class Lwjgl3SnapshotBackend`<br/>
**Implements:** [`ISnapshotBackend`](/reference/testing/isnapshotbackend/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.lwjgl3.snapshot` · **Module:** `backend-lwjgl3` · **Source:** [Lwjgl3SnapshotBackend.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/lwjgl3/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/lwjgl3/snapshot/Lwjgl3SnapshotBackend.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The snapshot backend of LWJGL 3, which renders in a hidden GLFW window with the OpenGL profile of the test run.

## Description

The system property `joid.snapshot.profile` picks a [`SnapshotProfile`](/reference/lwjgl3/snapshotprofile/); it ships in the dev and demo jars of the backend.
